title: Reliable User Simulation in Complex Multi-Step Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.34044v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based user simulators are increasingly used to evaluate conversational assistants. Yet, these simulators can drift from their assigned goals or fail to exhaustively explore all specified options, causing evaluation errors incorrectly attributed to the assistant. Prior work has examined goal alignment in single-task settings, but many practical scenarios require simulators to execute multi-step workflows with sequential tasks, fallback logic, and cross-task dependencies, where simulator fidelity has not been measured. To close this gap, we introduce a benchmark of 500 workflows represented using the Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) abstraction. Our experiments reveal that the simulator's fidelity degrades sharply with workflow complexity, and that goal drift accounts for the majority of failures. Fidelity also depends on the assistant's response style, with the same simulator scoring substantially better or worse across styles. To addr

translated_title: 复杂多步骤工作流中的可靠用户模拟
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的用户模拟器被越来越多地用于评估对话助手。然而，这些模拟器可能会偏离其被指定的目标，或无法穷尽地探索所有指定的选项，从而导致评估错误，并将本不属于助手的错误归咎于助手。先前的工作研究了单任务设置中的目标对齐问题，但许多实际场景要求模拟器执行包含顺序任务、回退逻辑和跨任务依赖关系的多步骤工作流，而模拟器在这种场景下的保真度尚未被测量。为弥补这一空白，我们引入了一个包含500个工作流的基准，这些工作流采用分层任务网络（HTN）抽象来表示。我们的实验表明，模拟器的保真度随工作流复杂度的增加而急剧下降，且目标漂移是大多数失败的主要原因。保真度还取决于助手的响应风格，同一个模拟器在不同风格下的得分可能存在显著差异。为了解决……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于分层任务网络（HTN）抽象、包含500个工作流的基准，揭示出LLM用户模拟器在复杂多步骤工作流中的保真度随复杂度急剧下降，且目标漂移是导致失败的主要因素。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a benchmark of 500 workflows based on the Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) abstraction, revealing that LLM-based user simulators' fidelity degrades sharply with workflow complexity and that goal drift accounts for the majority of failures.
